title: Golden Trace Vergleich
input:
Vergleiche:

```text
Run A → Golden Trace
Run B → Changed/Faulted Trace
```

Prüfe:

```text
missing events
additional events
timing deviation
signal deviation
state deviation
route deviation
fault deviation
```

MCP:
```text
trace.compare_golden
trace.find_first_divergence
trace.get_deviation_summary
```

PASS nur, wenn die `first credible divergence` bestimmt wird.
